llm.summary: The skill's requirements and runtime instructions are consistent with its stated purpose (mirroring a WordPress site over SSH and deploying a static build to Cloudflare Pages), but follow-up caution is warranted because the workflow copies server files locally and could expose sensitive data if not handled carefully.

dimensions.detail: Requested binaries (ssh, rsync, curl, git, gh, wrangler) and environment variables (SSH host/user/port/key, site URL/name) align with a workflow that SSHs into a server, mirrors rendered HTML, rsyncs site files, creates a GitHub repo, and deploys to Cloudflare Pages. gh/wrangler make sense for repo creation and Pages deployment.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to the migration task (test SSH, run wget on the server, rsync directories, parse HTML/CSS for referenced assets, fix URLs, deploy). However, Step 4's rsync of entire directories (wp-content/plugins, themes, wp-includes, uploads) and the temporary mirror introduce a real risk of copying PHP files, plugin config, or other sensitive server-side files to the local machine. The skill does mention using a temp dir and not committing credentials, but it doesn't explicitly instruct to exclude server-side code (e.g., .php, wp-config.php) from the rsync or to securely scrub/remove temporary copies before creating the deploy repo. That is a procedural security consideration rather than an incoherence.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec (instruction-only) — lowest install risk. Nothing is downloaded or written to disk by an installer in the skill bundle itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Required environment variables are limited to SSH connection info and site metadata, which are necessary for the stated task. Optional CF_ACCOUNT_ID and GH_REPO_VISIBILITY are reasonable for Pages deployment. The skill asks for an SSH key path and expects ssh-agent usage (some redundancy but understandable). No unrelated secrets are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill is instruction-only, disable-model-invocation is set (the skill will not be autonomously invoked by the model), and always is false. It does not request persistent system-level presence or modify other skills' configuration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says, but it will copy material from your WordPress server to your local machine during the migration. Before running: 1) Ensure you trust the machine running the skill and that your SSH key is secure; 2) Review and exclude sensitive server-side files (wp-config.php, .env files, plugin-specific config or private uploads) from rsync or from the repo before committing; 3) Inspect the generated ./build and ./public directories and the referenced-files.txt list before creating the GitHub repo or deploying to Cloudflare; 4) Securely delete temporary mirrors and any sensitive files after the migration; 5) Use private GitHub repos and verify Cloudflare account settings; 6) Because this is an instruction-only skill from an unknown source, consider running the commands manually the first time or in a controlled environment to confirm they behave as expected.
